title: H3.3 contributes to chromatin accessibility and transcription factor binding at promoter-proximal regulatory elements
authors: Amanuel Tafessu; Ryan O’Hara; Sara Martire; Altair L. Dube; Purbita Saha; Laura A. Banaszynski
one_liner_zh: 该文研究组蛋白变体H3.3对启动子染色质可及性和转录因子结合的影响，涉及TF-DNA互作但以实验基因组分析为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作相关但方法不匹配。
abstract: Background The histone variant H3.3 is enriched at active regulatory elements such as promoters and enhancers in mammalian genomes. These regions are highly accessible, creating an environment that is permissive to transcription factor binding and the recruitment of transcriptional coactivators that establish a unique chromatin post-translational landscape. How H3.3 contributes to the establishment and function of chromatin states at these regions is poorly understood. Results We performed genomic analyses of features associated with active promoter chromatin in mouse embryonic stem cells (ESCs) and found evidence of subtle yet widespread promoter dysregulation in the absence of H3.3. Loss of H3.3 deposition at promoters reduces chromatin accessibility and transcription factor (TF) footprinting for nearly all TFs expressed in ESCs. H3.3 deletion leads to reduced promoter enrichment of the transcriptional coactivator and histone acetyltransferase, p300. Subsequently, histone H3 acetylation at lysine 27 (H3K27ac) is reduced at promoters in the absence of H3.3, along with reduced enrichment of the bromodomain-containing protein BRD4, an acetyl lysine reader. Despite the observed chromatin dysregulation, H3.3 KO ESCs maintain transcription from ESC-specific genes. However, upon undirected differentiation, H3.3 KO cells retain footprinting of ESC-specific TFs motifs and fail to generate footprints of lineage-specific TF motifs, in line with their diminished capacity to differentiate. Conclusions H3.3 facilitates DNA accessibility, TF binding, and histone post-translational modification at active promoters. While H3.3 is not required for maintaining transcription in ESCs, it is required for TF binding at new promoters during differentiation.
abstract_zh: 背景 组蛋白变体H3.3在哺乳动物基因组中富集于活性调控元件，如启动子和增强子。这些区域高度可及，为转录因子结合及招募转录共激活因子创造了有利环境，从而建立独特的染色质翻译后修饰景观。H3.3如何在这些区域促进染色质状态的建立和功能，目前尚不清楚。结果 我们对小鼠胚胎干细胞（ESCs）中与活性启动子染色质相关的特征进行了基因组分析，并发现缺乏H3.3时存在细微但广泛的启动子失调证据。H3.3在启动子处的沉积缺失降低了染色质可及性，并减少了几乎所有在ESCs中表达的转录因子（TF）的足迹。H3.3缺失导致转录共激活因子和组蛋白乙酰转移酶p300在启动子处的富集减少。随后，在缺乏H3.3的情况下，启动子处组蛋白H3第27位赖氨酸的乙酰化（H3K27ac）水平降低，同时含溴结构域蛋白BRD4（一种乙酰赖氨酸阅读器）的富集也减少。尽管观察到染色质失调，H3.3敲除（KO）ESCs仍维持ESC特异性基因的转录。然而，在非定向分化过程中，H3.3 KO细胞保留了ESC特异性TF基序的足迹，但未能生成谱系特异性TF基序的足迹，这与其分化能力减弱一致。结论 H3.3促进活性启动子处的DNA可及性、TF结合及组蛋白翻译后修饰。虽然H3.3并非ESCs维持转录所必需，但在分化过程中，它对于新启动子处的TF结合是必需的。
